name: ZTZ-96 (Type 96)
protection: Welded turret with add-on composite and ERA on Type 96A. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW/NLAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: Low T-72-inspired hull with six road wheels per side
Type 96A: boxy add-on armour wedges on the turret front, ERA blocks on side skirts
Flat turret with storage baskets and smoke grenade banks
Most numerous PLA tank; older line units and reserve brigades
